description: Watch a flow that makes money: a real browser walks the steps on a schedule and alerts when one breaks (confirmed by a rerun). Step 1 opens a page on the app's own domain. A checkout flow ends with expect_checkout and never pays. Counts toward the plan's flows. Needs write access.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

url.description: A path like /pricing, or a full URL on the app's own domain

text.description: What the button or link says

label.description: The field's label or placeholder (never a card field)

secret.description: true for any secret (password, PIN, API key, one-time code): stored encrypted and never shown again. Labels containing "pass" are secret anyway.

value.description: {n} becomes a fresh number each run, for unique emails

price.description: Like $29. Omit to only check the checkout opens.

name: add_flow_check
title: Add a flow check
